crossRefs.note: How precious is your loving kindness, God! The children of men take refuge under the shadow of your wings.
Surely God is good to Israel, to those who are pure in heart.
You will guide me with your counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.
They will utter the memory of your great goodness, and will sing of your righteousness.
For from of old men have not heard, nor perceived by the ear, nor has the eye seen a God besides you, who works for him…
They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness.
But as it is written, “Things which an eye didn’t see, and an ear didn’t hear, which didn’t enter into the heart of…
See how great a love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God! For this cause the world…
Beloved, now we are children of God. It is not yet revealed what we will be; but we know that when he is revealed, we…
You will show me the path of life. In your presence is fullness of joy. In your right hand there are pleasures forever…
Then Yahweh’s ransomed ones will return, and come with singing to Zion; and everlasting joy will be on their heads.…
Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are on the earth.
For you both had compassion on me in my chains, and joyfully accepted the plundering of your possessions, knowing that…
Listen, my beloved brothers. Didn’t God choose those who are poor in this world to be rich in faith, and heirs of the…
to an incorruptible and undefiled inheritance that doesn’t fade away, reserved in Heaven for you,
who by the power of God are guarded through faith for a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.
Your God has commanded your strength. Strengthen, God, that which you have done for us.
Then our mouth was filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing. Then they said among the nations, “Yahweh has…
Yahweh has done great things for us, and we are glad.
Surely there is no enchantment with Jacob; Neither is there any divination with Israel. Now it shall be said of Jacob…
Yahweh, you will ordain peace for us, for you have also done all our work for us.
But he who does the truth comes to the light, that his works may be revealed, that they have been done in God.”
All the multitude kept silence, and they listened to Barnabas and Paul reporting what signs and wonders God had done…
Now he who made us for this very thing is God, who also gave to us the down payment of the Spirit.

translations.web: Oh how great is your goodness, which you have laid up for those who fear you, which you have worked for those who take refuge in you, before the sons of men!
translations.bsb: How great is Your goodness which You have laid up for those who fear You, which You have bestowed before the sons of men on those who take refuge in You!
translations.kjv: Oh how great is thy goodness, which thou hast laid up for them that fear thee; which thou hast wrought for them that trust in thee before the sons of men!
translations.asv: Oh how great is thy goodness, Which thou hast laid up for them that fear thee, Which thou hast wrought for them that take refuge in thee, Before the sons of men!
